media.prompt: A koi pond at night, deep green water with golden koi swirling under soft lantern light, dark cinematic atmosphere, fine detail

what: The 2022 latent diffusion model behind the first wave of open image tools; small and quick, with a large library of LoRAs and ControlNets.
dossier:
If the goal is inference and VRAM is a constraint:
       Then use v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors (uses less VRAM) [https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5/raw/main/README.md].
       Or use v1-5-pruned-emaonly-fp16.safetensors (FP16 conversion) [MODEL.md].
   If the goal is fine-tuning:
       Then use v1-5-pruned.safetensors (contains EMA and non-EMA weights, uses more VRAM) [https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5/raw/main/README.md].
   If a specific style is required and a community checkpoint is available locally:
       Then use DreamShaper_8_pruned.safetensors or interiordesignsuperm_v2.safetensors [MODEL.md].
